news.headline: Police pursue Zamboni on Highway 9
news.ticker: Driver says rec league went two minutes over their ice time   •   Zamboni top speed: 9 mph   •   Motorists advised to watch for fresh ice   •   Rink manager: "he does this every Tuesday"

subtitles.text: We're following a slow-speed pursuit on Highway 9.
Police say the driver refused to leave the rink
after his rec league went two minutes over their ice time.
